title_html: TikTok Shop vs. Amazon: Where the Next Incremental Dollar Should Go
description: TikTok Shop vs. Amazon isn't a rivalry question, it's where your next incremental dollar earns more. Real proof for 8- and 9-figure brands deciding the split.
dek: For a brand already clearing real volume on Amazon, TikTok Shop isn't a replacement channel — it's where the next incremental dollar can go further. Here's the honest math on where each platform earns its keep.
author: Jackie He
cta_pre: See where your next dollar goes further on TikTok Shop.
llms_summary: A platform-allocation framework, not a which-is-better comparison, for 8- and 9-figure brands already doing real Amazon volume deciding how much incremental budget to put into TikTok Shop next quarter. Covers where Amazon still wins (mature search intent, fulfillment infrastructure), where TikTok Shop wins on unit economics right now (reallocated ad budget returning 45% GMV growth month over month, GMV Max ROI improving as spend scales, affiliate-driven customer acquisition), and the test-and-scale framework Reach uses with clients to decide the split.

title_html: How the TikTok Shop Creator Marketplace Actually Works, Move by Move
description: The TikTok Shop Creator Marketplace only moves GMV when sourcing, seeding cadence, and commission structure run in order. Here's how the mechanics work.
dek: For a brand already doing real volume, the Creator Marketplace isn't a tool you check once a week. It's a bench: who you source, how often you seed them, what they earn, and when their content is proven enough to hand to GMV Max.

page_title: TikTok Shop Seller Fees: The Real Cost | Reach Social
og_title: TikTok Shop Seller Fees: What They Actually Cost at Scale
title_html: TikTok Shop Seller Fees: What They Actually Cost at Scale
description: TikTok Shop charges a flat 6% referral fee, not a blended take rate. Here's what that fee covers, what it doesn't, and where the real cost of scale sits.
dek: Every brand vetting TikTok Shop asks some version of the same question: what's the real take rate? The honest answer is that the platform fee is smaller and simpler than most brands expect — and the number that actually determines your margin at scale isn't published anywhere.
author: Jackie He
cta_pre: Model what TikTok Shop actually costs for your brand.
llms_summary: TikTok Shop's platform fee is a flat 6% referral fee on most US categories (5% on select jewelry, 3% for new sellers' first 30 days), calculated as fee-rate times (customer payment plus platform discount minus tax), with a refund administration fee capped at $5 per SKU. Payment processing figures are inconsistently reported publicly and should be confirmed in Seller Center. The real cost of scale is affiliate commission and ad spend, both of which the brand controls, not TikTok.
